Thai Vietnamese Pho Pad Thai
Saigon -2- Siam Bistro is a cozy, family-run gem tucked into a corner plaza on 1st St in downtown Gilroy. Formerly known as Saigon Bistro Express, the name—bridging "Saigon" for Vietnam and "Siam" for Thailand—perfectly captures the soul of the menu. It’s a place where you’ll find steaming bowls of Phở and crispy Bánh mì (Vietnamese baguettes) sharing the spotlight with Pad Thai, fragrant curries, and savory basil stir-fries. The vibe is classic American bistro with a Southeast Asian twist, featuring intricate wood carvings and textiles on the walls and comfortable booths by the windows. Most dishes let you pick your protein—chicken, pork, tofu, or veggie—and you can dial in your heat level from Mild all the way up to a punchy "Thai Spicy" right when you order. On the Vietnamese side of things, the Phở features a clean, hearty beef bone broth accented with black pepper and onions. They serve the thinly sliced raw beef on a separate plate so you can swirl it into the hot soup to cook it yourself, accompanied by a fresh garnish plate of bean sprouts, Thai basil, jalapeños, and lime to customize your bowl. If you're craving Thai, the Pad Thai hits those perfect sweet-and-sour notes with its tamarind-based sauce, topped with plenty of crushed peanuts and sprouts. For something savory and aromatic, the Pad Gra Pao (basil stir-fry) brings together tender beef, carrots, and onions in a glossy oyster sauce with heaps of fresh basil. Don't miss the appetizers—the fried fish sticks and calamari are battered and fried to order, while the Thai Spicy Shrimp Salad is a bright, refreshing mix of red onions, tomatoes, and cilantro tossed in a zesty fish sauce and lime dressing. With a menu that rounds out with curries, fried rice, grilled meats, and drinks like Thai iced tea and Vietnamese coffee, there’s something for everyone. Perfect for family dinners, dining with kids, and anyone who wants to enjoy both Thai and Vietnamese flavors in one stop.
